memory.remembered: Saved to materials as a memory command
memory.allGone: None of these materials are in the library anymore (they may have been deleted already)
memory.notOnCard: Only materials listed on the card can be deleted. These aren't on it: {ids}
memory.range.reversed: The time range starts after it ends
memory.plugin.title: Memory
memory.plugin.summary: Turns what you've said into materials; remember, forget, purge and don't-infer commands; Ergo searches memory when answering
memory.plugin.purge.remember: What you asked Ergo to "remember" (the text in those memory commands)
memory.plugin.purge.stale: Records of suggestion and question cards left unhandled for a long time
memory.plugin.purge.cards: Every version of memory deletion cards (in chats and the inbox)
memory.plugin.purge.nightly: Nightly consolidation records (each night's report and any failure item in the inbox)
memory.plugin.keep.materials: Materials in the library (what you've said, saved web pages, things to remember): materials belong to the core — to delete them, use bulk delete in Memory · Materials (Settings · Delete materials when the Memory plugin is gone)
memory.plugin.keep.commands: Records of forget, purge and don't-infer commands: they note which materials were deleted; without them, deleted materials would come back on a rebuild
memory.plugin.keep.backup: The copy in backup snapshots (goes away as snapshots rotate: about 7 days locally, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder)
memory.plugin.keep.reasoning: The reasoning DB (memory/subtext/rg.db in the data directory) is kept: it holds conclusions consolidated from materials and the consolidation records; rebuilding needs only the materials and loses no originals. Disabling or removing never deletes it
memory.plugin.keep.originals: Not one original material is touched: the reasoning DB only references materials, it never copies or rewrites them
memory.nightly.failed.title: Memory consolidation didn't finish ({night})
memory.nightly.failed.body: The 03:00 consolidation failed: {reason}. No material was lost; the next consolidation picks up where this one stopped.
memory.nightly.rebuild.title: Memory consolidation needs a rebuilt reasoning DB
memory.nightly.rebuild.body: The reasoning DB (memory/subtext/rg.db in the data directory) doesn't match this version of Ergo: {reason}. It was not migrated automatically; no material was lost, and rebuilding the reasoning DB loses no originals.
memory.nightly.reason.noKey: No DeepSeek key (environment variable DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) is configured, so this consolidation is skipped
memory.nightly.reason.busy: The previous consolidation is still running, so this one doesn't start on top of it: check the consolidation record when it finishes
memory.nightly.manual.title: Consolidate memory now
memory.nightly.manual.done: Consolidated: {newClaims} new conclusions, {changedClaims} changed, {open} questions open; {modelCalls} model calls this time
memory.nightly.manual.budget: (budget used up; the next consolidation continues)
memory.nightly.manual.off: Memory consolidation is turned off on this machine (memory.enabled is false)
memory.nightly.reason.timeout: Consolidation timed out: still not done after {minutes} minutes, so this night gives up (no material was lost; the next night runs as usual)
memory.nightly.issue.manifestMissing: The reasoning DB has no manifest (it may be from an older version, or the file isn't a reasoning DB)
memory.nightly.issue.schemaMismatch: The reasoning DB format version is {found}, and this version of Ergo expects {expected}
memory.nightly.issue.storeSchemaMismatch: The reasoning DB table version is {found}, and this version of Ergo expects {expected}
memory.graph.notBuilt: The reasoning DB hasn't been built yet: it exists after the nightly consolidation runs for the first time (that run needs a DeepSeek key configured)
memory.graph.busy: The nightly consolidation is using the reasoning DB right now; refresh again in a moment
memory.graph.readFailed: The reasoning DB can't be read: {detail}
memory.unknownMode: This version doesn't know this deletion mode ({mode})
memory.tool.woven: Note a question asked in passing
memory.curator.label: Memory curator
memory.curator.interrupted: The memory curator was interrupted before it finished; ask it again if you need it
memory.curator.interruptedQuoted: The memory curator was interrupted before it finished (it was working on: {quoted}); ask it again if you need it
memory.prompt.flag: True while the memory plugin is running (false when it's disabled in config plugins.disabled or failed to load): wraps the parts about memory commands (remember, forget, delete completely, don't infer), searching and reading materials, and the memory curator
memory.prompt.toolName232: Tool name (memory plugin, ticket 232: ask memory)
memory.prompt.toolName242: Tool name (memory plugin, ticket 242: ask the memory curator)
memory.plugin.purge.interviews: Get-to-know interview records (invites, starts and ends; what you said in interviews is material and stays)
memory.interview.card.weeklyTitle: Got 10 minutes to chat? This time: {topic}
memory.interview.card.monthlyTitle: Anything changed lately you'd like to talk about?
memory.interview.endedCovered_one: This interview is over: "{topic}" is marked as covered. The {n} thing you said is saved as material marked "from interview" and will be used in tonight's consolidation; the curator's summary is not written as a conclusion.
memory.interview.endedCovered_other: This interview is over: "{topic}" is marked as covered. The {n} things you said are saved as material marked "from interview" and will be used in tonight's consolidation; the curator's summary is not written as a conclusion.
memory.interview.endedOpen_one: Stopping here for now: "{topic}" isn't finished, we'll pick it up next time. The {n} thing you said is saved as material marked "from interview".
memory.interview.endedOpen_other: Stopping here for now: "{topic}" isn't finished, we'll pick it up next time. The {n} things you said are saved as material marked "from interview".
memory.interview.action.title: Start a get-to-know interview
memory.interview.action.done: The interview has started ({topic}); the memory curator is waiting in Memory · Curator.
memory.interview.action.already: An interview is already going on ({topic}); continue in Memory · Curator.
memory.plugin.interviewFilesCard: Interview profile check card (checked item by item when an interview wraps up)
memory.plugin.purge.interviewCards: Every version of interview invite cards and interview profile check cards (in chats and the inbox; what's already in your profiles stays)
memory.interview.files.inboxTitle: Profile details from the interview, please check each one
memory.interview.files.title: Profile details from the interview ({n})
memory.interview.files.unknownItem: That item isn't on this card
memory.interview.files.decided: That item has already been handled
memory.learned.notReady: Memory hasn't been consolidated yet (the reasoning store isn't ready)
